description: NoBrokerHood/society-specific accounting policies. None of these are defined in the project requirements or configuration, so each is POLICY_REQUIRED: the system reports them instead of assuming an answer. Set status to DEFINED and fill 'value' only when the business confirms the policy.

policies.question: Which ledger/expense code does each expense category post to?
Which code is used for each member bill head?
Which code identifies each society bank account?
What is the approved petty cash float / maximum cash payment per voucher?
Are staff salaries and salary advances allowed to be paid from petty cash?
Which TDS section and rate apply to each vendor, and what thresholds does the society apply?
Does the society claim GST input tax credit (GST to input ledger) or expense it (GST added to cost)?
Is there an NBH import template for petty cash registers? Until defined, register output is a review workbook, not an import file.
Maximum rupee difference accepted as rounding. 1.00 is a technical default pending confirmation.
